name: k9_affine_triangle_cover
lines: ⊢ ∀ (c₁ c₂ c₃ c₄ : Fin 4) (j₁ j₂ j₃ j₄ : ZMod 3),
k9_affine_triangle c₁ j₁ ∪ k9_affine_triangle c₂ j₂ ∪ k9_affine_triangle c₃ j₃ ∪ k9_affine_triangle c₄ j₄ =
(∃ c, ∀ (j : ZMod 3), (c, j) = (c₁, j₁) ∨ (c, j) = (c₂, j₂) ∨ (c, j) = (c₃, j₃) ∨ (c, j) = (c₄, j₄)) ∨
(c₁ ≠ c₂ ∧ c₁ ≠ c₃ ∧ c₁ ≠ c₄ ∧ c₂ ≠ c₃ ∧ c₂ ≠ c₄ ∧ c₃ ≠ c₄) ∧
v ∈ k9_affine_triangle c₂ j₂ ∧ v ∈ k9_affine_triangle c₃ j₃ ∧ v ∈ k9_affine_triangle c₄ j₄
